source_or_custodian: UN Inter-agency Group for Child Mortality Estimation (UNICEF, WHO, World Bank, United Nations Population Division), published via World Development Indicators (WDI, database WB_WDI) on World Bank Data360
status_or_notes: No value for 2025: the series' latest year on the server is 2024, so 2000-2024 is returned (25 of the 26 requested years). The server returned no uncertainty bounds. Annual periodicity. Nigeria is covered (NGA). Metadata caveats: estimates are model-based UN IGME best-estimate trend lines; vital registration is incomplete in many developing countries, so surveys and indirect estimates are used.
definition: Under-five mortality rate is the probability per 1,000 that a newborn baby will die before reaching age five, if subject to age-specific mortality rates of the specified year.
citation: UN Inter-agency Group for Child Mortality Estimation (UNICEF, WHO, World Bank, UN Population Division), www.childmortality.org, via World Bank World Development Indicators, indicator SH.DYN.MORT. The server gave no separate citation_requirement.
